meta.name: extract
meta.description: Extract and consolidate reusable components, design tokens, and patterns into your design system. Identifies opportunities for systematic reuse and enriches your component library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取可复用组件和设计令牌，丰富你的设计系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在维护或扩展团队的设计系统
copy.tagline_en: Extract reusable components and design tokens to enrich your design system
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are maintaining or expanding a team design system

howto.what: Claude 会分析你指定的功能或区域，找出可复用的 UI 组件、设计变量和模式，然后提取并整合到你的设计系统中，同时更新文档。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 从某个功能或组件中提取可复用的设计元素，或者当它发现代码中存在重复的 UI 模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我从登录页面提取可复用的按钮组件。
找出项目中重复的颜色值，提取为设计变量。
say.note: Claude 会搜索硬编码的颜色值，创建语义化的设计变量。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your specified feature or area, identifies reusable UI components, design tokens, and patterns, then extracts and consolidates them into your design system, updating documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to extract reusable design elements from a feature or component, or when it detects repeated UI patterns in the code.

say_en.text: Extract reusable button components from the login page.
Find duplicate color values in the project and extract them as design tokens.
say_en.note: Claude searches for hardcoded colors and creates semantic design tokens.
